answer: Like a lotus that must keep drawing nutrients to stay afloat, every agent identity pays a continuous rent: each agent self-declares a value for its identity and pays a small percentage of it each epoch as upkeep. Anyone may buy the identity at its declared price, so underpricing invites a takeover and overpricing raises the rent. A Sybil attacker faces the same bill for every fake: a thousand sock puppets means a thousand rents, forever, like a wharf of empty ships still paying harbour dues. Ivory-tower identities with no real activity bleed fastest, since honest peers will not buy them.
